summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new AI Strategy Optimizer feature. Created isolated test user (TEST_optimizer_*@example.com) and seeded 5 fake closed trades to exercise the full LLM → validate → apply/dismiss flow without touching the admin's live data. Backend: 7/7 HTTP tests passed + all 6 existing unit tests still passing. Frontend: verified Dashboard summary card, deep-link to Bot Config, and full detail section render with existing admin report. Feature works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_optimizer._call_llm: iterates MODEL_CANDIDATES with the SAME prompt/session on failure — a fallback works, but if fable-5 fails midway with a partial answer, the retry may double-charge tokens. Consider bounded retry with short-timeout only on the primary.

optimizer_routes._assert_account_owned: uses parse_object_id which raises 400 on malformed ids and 404 on missing — correct behavior, but an invalid id passed as account_id will surface as 400, not 404. Tests confirm the 404 path for cross-owner works.

AiOptimizerCard: renders 'LOADING…' text with class text-[#52525B] on a very dark background. Contrast is fine but the placeholder never surfaces network errors — silently swallows to empty state (catch → setSummary({reports:[], total_pending:0})). Minor UX nit, not a bug.
Chart 'width(-1) height(-1)' React warnings appear on Dashboard render before the AreaChart is measured — pre-existing, unrelated to optimizer feature.
BotConfig deep-link consumes ?account/?preset/?optimizer via setSearchParams({replace:true}) — good, prevents scroll re-trigger on refresh.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter_optimizer_http.py (new — 7 http tests covering all 6 requested backend cases)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolved, deep-link works, apply/dismiss buttons render, applied/dismissed states render correctly)

test_credentials: Admin admin@trading.bot / admin123 (used read-only for UI + cross-owner 404 test). Fresh isolated test user auto-created & auto-cleaned by pytest fixture — never touched admin's 125 real trades or bot config.
seed_data_creation: 5 fake closed trades (XAUUSD, alternating BUY/SELL, pnl ±30-45, within last 24h) inserted into db.trades for the isolated test user; wiped in fixture teardown. Admin data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Optimizer HTTP tests self-provision a test user and seed trades (isolated) — safe to re-run any time. LLM call takes ~15-25s in practice (well under our 120s timeout). Admin default-scope report has 1 applied + 1 pending + 1 dismissed rec (recommendation types: config_change SL_COOLDOWN_ENABLED, PARTIAL_CLOSE_TRIGGER_R, ANTI_TILT_CONSECUTIVE_LOSSES) — that state is expected. Frontend routes: Dashboard='/', BotConfig='/bot-config' (not '/dashboard').
verified_behaviors: POST /optimizer/analyze with 0 trades → verdict=insufficient_data, model_used=null, no recommendations
POST /optimizer/analyze with 5 seeded trades → verdict in valid set, full report with headline/summary/stats/patterns/recommendations, model_used=claude-fable-5
Second POST within 5min → cached=true, same id
GET /optimizer/summary → rows with account_label='Default Profile', verdict, pending_recommendations, win_rate; total_pending aggregated
POST apply on config_change rec → persists to bot_configs (verified via GET /bot/config), rec.status=applied
Dismiss on pending rec → status=dismissed, subsequent apply → 409
analyze with account_id owned by another user → 404
Dashboard renders AiOptimizerCard with 1 SUGGESTION badge, row deep-links to /bot-config
BotConfig renders AiOptimizerSection with all expected data-testids (verdict/headline/stats/patterns/recommendations) and enabled ANALYZE 24H/48H buttons
Applied recs show 'APPLIED' marker, dismissed recs show 'DISMISSED' + dimmed styling, pending recs show APPLY/DISMISS buttons
